- Format: GitHub repo (private) + single PDF (rationale).
- We expect code + a README with reproducible run steps and a short note on tradeoffs.

Attachments included: project_atlas_brief_v1.pdf, atlas_evaluation_rubric.md
Submission link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/atlas-brief-20261120 (upload to the folder and include a README commit)
